overview: Iteration 5: Core Ordering Flow — Reduce Customer Wait Time. Wire the existing deposit-optional setting into the approve action so kitchen starts immediately, build a Kitchen Display System (KDS) tablet page so kitchen sees orders without waiting for FeedMe entry, add SSE for instant admin notifications, bulk-approve with smart ready-time suggestions, customer Web Push on order ready, and improved order status UX.
goals: Wire depositRequired into approve action: when OFF, approval immediately sets status to 'preparing' so kitchen can start without waiting for T&G deposit
Build /kitchen KDS page — tablet-optimized, shows live preparing/approved orders with ETA countdown and color-coded urgency
Add kitchen PIN auth (/kitchen/login) separate from admin auth
Replace 30s admin polling with SSE for instant new-order notifications (Edge Runtime, <1s latency)
Add Bulk Approve with smart estimated-ready time suggestion (base 10 min + 2 min per item line)
Notify customers via Web Push when their order is ready (reuse existing VAPID infra)
Improve order status page: expiry countdown, clearer messaging per depositRequired state, WhatsApp fallback

userStories.title: Wire depositRequired into approve action
userStories.description: The depositRequired boolean already exists in SiteSettings (type, default: false, admin toggle in settings panel) but the approve action in /api/admin/orders/[id] always sets status='approved' regardless. Wire it: when depositRequired=false, approval sets status='preparing' directly. When depositRequired=true, keep existing approved→payment flow. Customer status page must show correct messaging for each branch.

depositRequired=false: sets status='preparing' (not 'approved'); estimatedReady still saved if provided
depositRequired=true: existing behaviour unchanged (status='approved', customer must upload T&G)
GET /api/settings (public) includes depositRequired field so client pages can read it
Customer /order/[id] page: when depositRequired=false AND status is 'preparing', hides T&G payment section, shows 'Your order is confirmed — kitchen is preparing your food'
Customer /order/[id] page: when depositRequired=true, existing payment upload section shows as before
Admin order card still shows correct action buttons regardless of depositRequired value

userStories.title: Kitchen PIN auth (/kds/login — implemented at /kds)
userStories.description: Add a simple PIN-based auth gate for the /kitchen route, separate from admin JWT. Kitchen staff enter a PIN on /kitchen/login; a kitchen_token JWT cookie is issued (role: kitchen, 12h expiry). Admin sets the PIN in the Settings tab. A verifyKitchenToken() helper is added to auth.ts for use by kitchen API routes.
acceptanceCriteria: /kitchen/login page: numeric PIN input (4-6 digits), submit button, error message on wrong PIN
Correct PIN → POST /api/kitchen/auth → sets kitchen_token HttpOnly JWT cookie → redirect to /kitchen
Wrong PIN → 'Incorrect PIN' error shown inline (no redirect)
kitchen_token is a JWT signed with ADMIN_JWT_SECRET, payload { role: 'kitchen' }, expires 12h
verifyKitchenToken(request: Request) added to src/lib/auth.ts — reads kitchen_token cookie, returns payload or null
POST /api/kitchen/auth: reads kitchenPin from getSiteSettings(); 5 failed attempts per IP → 60s lockout (in-memory)
kitchenPin field added to SiteSettings type with default '1234'; DEFAULT_SETTINGS updated
Admin Settings panel: new 'Kitchen PIN' text input field (shows current PIN, allows change)
No i18n required for kitchen pages — English only
/kitchen page: if no valid kitchen_token cookie, redirects to /kitchen/login (client-side check on mount)

userStories.title: Kitchen Display System (KDS) — /kitchen page
userStories.description: Build the /kitchen tablet page that shows live orders needing kitchen action. Orders sorted by customer ETA (soonest first). Color-coded urgency. One-tap 'Start Preparing' and 'Mark Ready' buttons. Auto-refreshes every 5 seconds via polling. Uses dedicated kitchen API routes authenticated with kitchen_token.
acceptanceCriteria: GET /kitchen: redirects to /kitchen/login if no valid kitchen_token
Shows orders in 'preparing' status + 'approved' status (approved orders appear only when depositRequired=false)
Orders sorted by estimated_arrival ASC NULLS LAST (no ETA orders go to bottom)
Each order card shows: short order ID, item list with quantities, total (RM), customer ETA (formatted time), time elapsed since order created, deposit status badge
Deposit status badge: 'Paid' (payment_screenshot_url exists) | 'Not Required' (depositRequired=false) | 'Pending' (depositRequired=true, not yet paid)
ETA urgency colour: RED border/bg ≤5 min remaining, YELLOW 6-10 min, GREEN >10 min, GREY no ETA
Per-card buttons: 'Start Preparing' (approved→preparing, only shown if status=approved) | 'Mark Ready ✓' (preparing→ready, only shown if status=preparing)
Page header: 'Kitchen Display' title, auto-refresh indicator ('↻ Auto-refresh every 5s'), last-refreshed timestamp
Empty state: 'No active orders — kitchen is clear 🎉'
Layout: 1-column on mobile, 2-column on ≥768px (tablet landscape), large readable text, touch targets ≥56px
GET /api/kitchen/orders: returns preparing + approved orders (kitchen-auth-gated)
PATCH /api/kitchen/orders/[id]: accepts { action: 'start' | 'ready' }, updates status accordingly (kitchen-auth-gated)

userStories.title: Admin SSE for real-time new order notifications
userStories.description: Replace the 30-second admin polling in AdminOrdersBell with a Server-Sent Events connection so the admin sees new orders within 3 seconds of submission. Uses Edge Runtime to avoid Vercel's 60s serverless timeout. Includes heartbeat, auto-reconnect, and graceful fallback to 30s polling if SSE is unsupported.
acceptanceCriteria: GET /api/admin/orders/stream: Edge Runtime SSE endpoint, auth-gated (reads admin JWT cookie)
Server polls for new pending_approval orders every 3s and emits 'new_order' event with { id, total, itemCount, createdAt }
Emits 'heartbeat' comment (': ping') every 20s to keep connection alive
Response headers include: Content-Type: text/event-stream, Cache-Control: no-cache, X-Accel-Buffering: no
Client (AdminOrdersBell): on mount creates EventSource('/api/admin/orders/stream')
On 'new_order' event: increment unread badge count, trigger the existing bell animation/sound
On SSE disconnect/error: attempt reconnect after 5s, up to 3 attempts; after 3 failures fall back to 30s setInterval polling
Admin dashboard header shows a small status indicator: green dot 'Live' when SSE connected, grey 'Polling' when fallback active
On component unmount: close EventSource connection (prevent memory leak)
Existing 30s polling in useAdminOrders hook is kept as-is (for order list refresh) — SSE only replaces the bell notification polling
technicalNotes: Create: src/app/api/admin/orders/stream/route.ts
Use: export const runtime = 'edge' and export const dynamic = 'force-dynamic'
Edge Runtime + Neon: import { neon } from '@neondatabase/serverless' directly (NOT sql from @/lib/db which uses Pool — Pool is not edge-compatible)
Use: const sql = neon(process.env.DATABASE_URL!); then: await sql`SELECT id FROM tray_orders WHERE status='pending_approval' AND created_at > ${lastCheck}`
Auth in Edge: manually parse the admin JWT cookie from request.headers.get('cookie') — verifyAdminToken() from auth.ts uses Node.js APIs; instead use jose's jwtVerify() directly with the JWT secret
Track lastCheck as a local variable inside the ReadableStream start() function, initialized to new Date().toISOString()
Client: edit src/components/admin/admin-orders-bell.tsx — add useEffect with new EventSource, onmessage handler, onerror reconnect logic
Reconnect pattern: use a ref to track attempt count; setTimeout(reconnect, 5000) on error; after 3 attempts, clearEventSource and start setInterval fallback
The 'Live'/'Polling' indicator: a small state variable in AdminOrdersBell, render as a colored dot with text near the bell icon

userStories.title: Bulk approve with smart estimated-ready time
userStories.description: Add an 'Approve All Pending (N)' button to the admin Orders tab for approving multiple orders at once during lunch rush. Smart ready-time formula auto-calculates estimated_ready for each order. Single-order approve modal also pre-fills with the smart suggestion.
acceptanceCriteria: 'Approve All Pending (N)' button appears in the Pending Approval tab when N > 0
Clicking opens a confirmation modal: 'Approve all N pending orders? Ready times will be auto-calculated.'
POST /api/admin/orders/bulk-approve: approves all pending_approval orders, calculates estimated_ready per order using smart formula
Smart formula: estimatedReady = now + max(10, min(30, 10 + 2 * items.length)) minutes (unique line count, not total quantity)
Bulk approve respects depositRequired: if false → status='preparing'; if true → status='approved'
After bulk approve: order list refreshes, success toast 'N orders approved'
Partial failure: toast shows 'X approved, Y failed' without blocking
Single-order approve modal: 'Estimated Ready Time' datetime-local input pre-filled with smart suggestion (admin can override before confirming)
Both bulk and single approve use the same calculateSmartReadyTime(items) helper
technicalNotes: Create: src/app/api/admin/orders/bulk-approve/route.ts — POST, verifyAdminToken(), loops through pending orders
Create: src/lib/orders.ts — export function calculateSmartReadyTime(items: {id:string,quantity:number}[]): Date
Formula: const mins = Math.max(10, Math.min(30, 10 + 2 * items.length)); return new Date(Date.now() + mins * 60000)
Bulk approve query: SELECT id, items FROM tray_orders WHERE status='pending_approval'
For each order: UPDATE tray_orders SET status=${newStatus}, estimated_ready=${readyTime} WHERE id=${id}
Edit: src/components/admin/admin-orders-panel.tsx — add bulk approve button in Pending tab header
Edit the single-approve modal (wherever it lives) — import calculateSmartReadyTime, call it with order.items, use result as defaultValue for the datetime-local input
The bulk approve button should only be visible when the 'Pending Approval' tab is active and pending count > 0
Use Promise.allSettled() for the loop — don't abort if one fails

userStories.title: Customer Web Push notification on order ready
userStories.description: Let customers opt-in to a Web Push notification on the /order/[id] status page. When admin marks the order as ready, a push is sent to the customer's browser. Reuses existing VAPID keys and web-push package already installed. iOS without PWA install shows a WhatsApp fallback instead.

On iOS where push is unavailable without PWA (detected via userAgent + display-mode check): button is hidden, show 'We'll update your status here' text instead
Clicking 'Notify me': browser permission prompt → on grant, subscribe via pushManager.subscribe() → POST /api/orders/[id]/push-subscribe

After subscribing: button changes to '✓ Notifications on' and becomes disabled
When admin marks order ready (action=mark_ready in PATCH /api/admin/orders/[id]): queries order_push_subscriptions for that order_id, calls webpush.sendNotification()
Push payload: { title: 'Order Ready! 🍽️', body: 'Your order is ready for pickup at Makan Moments Cafe', url: '/order/{id}' }

userStories.title: Improved order status page UX
userStories.description: Improve /order/[id] with an expiry countdown, clearer per-stage messaging that accounts for depositRequired, WhatsApp fallback CTA on rejection/expiry, a 'last updated' indicator, and a confetti celebration when status becomes ready.
acceptanceCriteria: When status='pending_approval': show expiry countdown 'Expires in X min Y sec' counting down from created_at + orderExpiryMinutes; turns red when < 5 min remaining
When order expires: message 'This order expired as it wasn't confirmed in time. Please WhatsApp us to re-order.' + WhatsApp CTA button
When status='rejected': rejection reason shown prominently, WhatsApp CTA 'Message us to re-order' with pre-filled text 'Hi, my order #ORDERID was rejected...'
When depositRequired=false AND status='preparing': hide T&G payment section, show 'Order confirmed — kitchen is preparing your food 🍳'
When depositRequired=true AND status='approved': show existing payment upload section unchanged
'Last updated X sec ago' text that increments every second; resets to 0 on each successful poll response
When status changes to 'ready' (detected on poll): show full-screen CSS confetti animation for 3 seconds (emoji-based, no JS library)
'Copy order ID' button on all terminal statuses (ready, rejected, expired): copies '#ORDERID' to clipboard, shows 'Copied!' tooltip
